name: Technology
tagline: Build the systems everything else runs on
description: Software, data and infrastructure. You solve problems by building things that scale, and you are comfortable being wrong quickly on the way to being right.

name: Design
tagline: Decide how it looks, feels and works
description: Product, visual and experience design. You care about the gap between what a thing does and how it feels to use, and you can argue for a decision without saying 'it looks nicer'.

name: Business
tagline: Turn direction into decisions
description: Strategy, operations, marketing and management. You are energised by moving people and resources toward an outcome, and comfortable owning the result.

name: Healthcare
tagline: Work where the stakes are people
description: Clinical practice, allied health and public health. You want your competence to matter to someone directly, and you can hold steady when it counts.

name: Finance
tagline: Make the numbers tell the truth
description: Accounting, analysis, banking and investment. You trust evidence over instinct and you find precision satisfying rather than tedious.

name: Media
tagline: Hold attention and earn it
description: Content, journalism, film and communications. You think in audience and narrative, and you would rather be understood than admired.

name: Engineering
tagline: Design and build what the physical world runs on
description: Civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering. You like knowing exactly why a thing works, and you are comfortable being responsible when it has to keep working.

name: Science & Research
tagline: Find out what is actually true
description: Laboratory, field and research science. You would rather test an idea than argue for it, and you can live with an experiment that takes months to say no.

name: Education
tagline: Help other people understand
description: Teaching, lecturing, counselling and learning design. You get more from someone else finally getting it than from getting it yourself.

name: Law & Justice
tagline: Argue precisely for what is fair
description: Advocacy, legal advice and the courts. You read closely, you enjoy a well-built argument, and detail that others skip is where you win.

name: Government & Public Service
tagline: Run the systems a country depends on
description: Civil service, diplomacy and public policy. You care about outcomes at scale and you have the patience to move large institutions.

name: Armed Forces & Security
tagline: Protect people under pressure
description: Army, navy, air force and police. You want structure, responsibility and a job where discipline and courage both count.

name: Architecture & Construction
tagline: Shape the places people live in
description: Architecture, planning, surveying and construction management. You think in space and cost at the same time.

name: Agriculture & Environment
tagline: Feed people and look after the land
description: Crops, animals, food and the environment. You want work that is close to living things and to the problems that matter for decades.

name: Hospitality & Tourism
tagline: Make people feel looked after
description: Hotels, kitchens, travel and events. You are energised by people, you stay calm when a hundred things are happening, and the details of an experience matter to you.

name: Aviation & Transport
tagline: Keep people and aircraft moving safely
description: Flying, maintaining and controlling aircraft, and the crews that look after passengers. Procedure, precision and responsibility come first.

name: Sports & Fitness
tagline: Build performance in bodies and teams
description: Coaching, training, nutrition and the business of sport. You like measurable progress and you know motivation is a skill.

name: Social Work & Development
tagline: Change things for people who need it most
description: Social work, NGOs, community development and humanitarian response. You want your effort to land on real people and you can hold steady in hard situations.

name: Fashion & Beauty
tagline: Turn taste into something people wear
description: Fashion and textile design, makeup and merchandising. You notice what others miss about how things look and why people want them.

name: Skilled Trades
tagline: Fix and build with your hands
description: Electrical, automotive, cooling and fabrication trades. You like visible results, practical problems and skills that are always in demand.
